exact_consequence.notation: a(r)=-w′(r)/(r*w(r)); b_v(r)=-deriv(n04bStateLogExponent D S C v)(r)/r; P=stateGrading S base v
exact_consequence.claim: epsilon*abs(b_v(r)) <= a(r)*P on each actual open negative component
exact_consequence.proof: At t=0 the actual state-line provider yields a>0. If a*P<epsilon*abs b, b is nonzero and t=-a/b lies in the original state ball; the true affine radicand is then zero, contradicting positivity. No division by P is used.
exact_consequence.does_not_claim: A uniform inverse lower bound for the reference root divisor or arbitrary profile bump availability.

direction_analysis.proved_facts: The supplied state space changes the profile only through the nu direction chi and the sum of its actual controls. On a fixed negative component, chi and all other controls vanish. The remaining control has tsupport strictly inside that open component. Consequently these profile directions vanish on a one-sided collar of each actual root.
direction_analysis.consequence: The new direction test is useful and noncircular, but its root limit is 0<=0. It cannot itself supply a nonzero root test.

direction_analysis.proved_facts: n04b_heightPair_of_compact_radial and exists_heightPair_germ_of_nonaxis supply actual decoded HeightPair elements. At a radial reference, the exact first characteristic-speed variation is -v_ref*(1+w^2)/w*(u_r+u_thetatheta/r); a radial increment gives -v_ref*(1+w^2)/w*f′.
direction_analysis.consequence: This concrete first variation multiplies the reference speed rather than its inverse. A qualitative local germ theorem does not bound the actual grading of the selected test. No assertion about all higher variations or all global inverse consequences is made.

direction_analysis.proved_facts: The contract controls a weak normal derivative of G F in weighted L2 by the source and its angular derivative in weighted L2. Its existing implementation uses scalar weighted Caccioppoli plus the real mode inverse, actual mode identification and Fourier reconstruction.
direction_analysis.consequence: This is not an existing pointwise root-kappa estimate. The Caccioppoli stage uses positive w, its quantitative cell upper/inverse estimates and the true radial ODE, without a quantitative w′′(root) hypothesis. This does not show the full inverse predicate cannot imply such a lower bound.

minimal_unfinished_inverse_test_route.current_limit: The last quantitative detecting family has not been constructed or proved.
